title: 云原生基础设施在 AI 工作负载下强化隔离、治理与采购集成
english: Recent announcements point to a common operational theme: AI workloads require stronger control planes and isolation boundaries. OpenAI introduced Control Room to track model workloads across its research infrastructure and rapidly stop them for safety or security concerns. CNCF research reports that virtual machines remain important alongside containers, with workload isolation becoming more significant for AI. Hyperlight targets Linux applications in hypervisor-isolated micro-VMs, including agent-generated code and customer-uploaded plugins. On the commercial side, ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, using existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships. These developments connect AI adoption with infrastructure governance, secure execution, and enterprise procurement.
chinese: 多项发布指向同一运维议题：AI 工作负载正在推动基础设施更重视可观测、可停止和强隔离能力。OpenAI 的 Control Room 用于跨研究基础设施跟踪模型工作负载，并在出现安全或安保问题时快速停止。CNCF 研究指出，虚拟机仍与容器并存，AI 场景中工作负载隔离的重要性正在提高。Hyperlight 面向运行于虚拟机监控器隔离 micro-VM 中的 Linux 应用，覆盖 AI Agent 刚生成的代码及客户上传插件等不完全可信的执行内容。同时，ChatGPT Enterprise 进入 AWS Marketplace，可借助现有 AWS 采购和计费关系简化采购。
why_it_matters: 对云原生与 AIOps 团队而言，AI 平台不只是部署模型，还需要覆盖工作负载追踪、紧急停止、执行隔离和采购接入的运营能力。对 Agent Infra 而言，Agent 生成代码与外部插件带来的不可信执行问题，使 micro-VM 和虚拟机级隔离成为需要评估的运行时选项。职业上，具备容器与虚拟机混合架构、安全控制面和企业级 AI 平台治理经验的运维开发能力更具相关性。
interview_expression: I would treat AI workload operations as a control-plane problem: teams need to track workloads, stop them quickly when required, and isolate untrusted execution. I also see virtual machines and containers as complementary options rather than mutually exclusive choices for AI infrastructure.
